name: Fluidomat Limited
summary: Fluidomat Limited manufactures and distributes fixed and variable speed fluid couplings. These components are widely utilized across a variety of industrial sectors, notably in thermal power generation, steel and metal processing, cement production, paper mills, chemical and fertilizer manufacturing, as well as coal and ore mining operations, and port handling facilities. The company was founded by Ashok Jain in 1971 and is based in Dewas, India.
